### Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(rprojroot)
  library(ggsci)
  library(readr)
})
```

### Data Wrangling

```{r setup-paths}
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-rna-expression")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# File path for counts
rnaseq_file <- file.path(data_dir, "gene-counts-rsem-expected_count-collapsed.all.rds")

# File path for histology
histology_file <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "histology-preprocessing", "results", "histologies.tsv")
```

```{r load-and-clean-histology}
# define which histologies to keep
keep_histologies <- c("DIPG or DMG", "EPN", "MB", "LGG", "Normal")
batch1_ids <- c("2-1578-CC1", "3-1890-CC1")

histology_df <- read_delim(histology_file) %>%
  filter(experimental_strategy == "RNA-Seq") %>%
  mutate(histology = coalesce(histology, "Normal"),
         sample_id = case_when(
           external_sample_id == "1516-T" ~ "7316-NA",
           external_sample_id %in% paste0("B", 1:5) ~ external_sample_id,
           TRUE ~ sample_id),
         batch = if_else(external_sample_id %in% batch1_ids, "batch1", "batch2"),
         condition = case_when(
           sample_type %in% c("Tumor", "Normal") ~ histology,
           sample_type == "Normal-Tumor Adjacent"~ paste0(histology, "-adjacent Normal"),
           TRUE ~ NA_character_
           ),
         histology_condition = case_when(
           sample_type %in% c("Tumor", "Normal") ~ histology,
           sample_type == "Normal-Tumor Adjacent" ~ "Normal-Tumor Adjacent",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_
           )
         ) %>%
  filter(histology %in% keep_histologies)
```

```{r load-and-filter-counts}
# load & filter genes with at least two non-zero samples
rnaseq_counts <- readRDS(rnaseq_file) %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(everything(), ~ . != 0)) >= 2)

# subset to samples in histology
valid_ids <- histology_df$Bioassay_ID
rnaseq_counts <- rnaseq_counts[, intersect(colnames(rnaseq_counts), valid_ids), drop = FALSE]
```

```{r align-metadata-to-counts}
histology_df <- histology_df %>%
  arrange(match(Bioassay_ID, names(rnaseq_counts)))
```

### PCA

```{r run-pca}
# Round expected counts to nearest integer
rnaseq_mat <- round(rnaseq_counts)

# Create DESeq2 object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = rnaseq_mat,
                              colData = histology_df,
                              design = ~ histology_condition)

# VST transformation
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind = FALSE)

# PCA plot
pca_data <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("histology_condition", "batch"), returnData = TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"))

P1 <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color=histology_condition, shape=batch)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  scale_color_jco(name = "Condition") +
  labs(title = "PCA",
       x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "%"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "%")) +
  theme_Publication()
print(P1)

# Save plot
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, "rna-pca.pdf"), plot = P1, width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r count-sample}
# Count sample types per histology
sample_summary <- histology_df %>%
  filter(sample_type %in% c("Tumor", "Normal-Tumor Adjacent")) %>%
  count(histology, sample_type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(histology)

# View the result
print(sample_summary)

# Save to CSV if needed
#write.csv(sample_summary, "sample_type_counts_by_histology.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### PCA by Tumor Type vs Controls

```{r run-pca-by-type}
tumor_types <- c("DIPG or DMG", "EPN", "LGG", "MB")
controls <- c("B1", "B2", "B3", "B4", "B5")

for (tumor in tumor_types) {
  tumor_samples <- histology_df %>% filter(histology == tumor & sample_type == "Tumor")
  adjacent_normals <- histology_df %>% filter(sample_type == "Normal-Tumor Adjacent" & histology == tumor)
  healthy_normals <- histology_df %>% filter(external_sample_id %in% controls)

  subset_metadata <- bind_rows(tumor_samples, adjacent_normals, healthy_normals)
  subset_cts <- rnaseq_mat[, subset_metadata$Bioassay_ID]

  dds_subset <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = subset_cts,
                                       colData = subset_metadata,
                                       design = ~ sample_type)
  vsd_subset <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_subset, blind = FALSE)

  pca_data <- plotPCA(vsd_subset, intgroup = "sample_type", returnData = TRUE)
  percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"))
  pca_data$Bioassay_ID <- rownames(pca_data)
  pca_data$sample_id <- subset_metadata$sample_id
  
  #define color mapping
  col_map <- c(
    "Tumor" = "#868686FF",
    "Normal" = "#0073C2FF",
    "Normal-Tumor Adjacent" = "#EFC000FF"
  )
  
  # only keep the ones actually present
  present <- unique(pca_data$sample_type)
  col_map <- col_map[present]

  # Now use sample_id for label
  p <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = sample_type, shape = sample_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Sample Type", values = col_map) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_id), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
  labs(title = paste("PCA -", tumor, "vs Controls"),
       x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  theme_Publication()
  
  print(p)
  
  ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("rna-pca-", tumor, "-vs-controls.pdf")), plot = p, width = 10, height = 6)
}
```
